Resilio Sync by linuxserver.io.description:
Fast, private peer-to-peer file synchronization for teams and individuals.

Based on a custom OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture.
Resilio Sync by linuxserver.io.more_info:
Sync folders

The data Share is mounted at /sync, which is the folder to choose when adding sync folders in the Resilio Sync WebUI. Additional Shares can be added with the Add Storage button; map them below /sync (e.g. /sync/Photos) so they are visible in the WebUI.

Moving from the previous Resilio Sync Rock-on

The earlier Rock-on used the official resilio/sync image, which stopped at version 2.8.1. Its config and state are not compatible with this layout, so set up this Rock-on fresh with a new config Share and re-add your existing data Shares as sync folders.

55555.description: Port for incoming data. You may need to open it (protocol: tcp and udp) on your firewall.
55555.label: Listening port [must be 55555]

/config.description: Share for Resilio Sync configuration and state.
/config.label: Config Storage [e.g. resiliosync-config]

/sync.description: Share for synced data. Additional Shares can be added after install.
/sync.label: Data Storage [e.g. resiliosync-data]

PGID.description: Enter a valid GID to use along with the same UID. It (or the above UID) must have full permissions to all Shares mapped in the previous step.
PGID.label: GID

PUID.description: Enter a valid UID to run Resilio Sync with. It must have full permissions to all Shares mapped in the previous step.
PUID.label: UID
